result: Final independent QA passed the requested backend and frontend commands. Mutation audit classification is now corrected: 401/403 are denied, other 4xx are failure, 5xx are failure, and successful responses are success; exceptions remain failure. Owner-only denials and viewer-denied mutations are audited. Legacy migration, security-stamp stale-cookie rejection, account-local password changes, owner/admin/viewer authorization, and CSRF route filters remain statically consistent. No secret-bearing fields are written to audit details. Account/audit UI screens remain unimplemented follow-up work.

evidence.outcome: Passed; Vite production build completed with existing SignalR Rollup annotation warnings.
Audit outcome mapping explicitly uses 401/403=denied, status >=400=failure, otherwise success.
Viewer and non-owner owner-group mutation attempts are audited as denied and return 403.
Cookie validation rejects deleted accounts or mismatched security stamps.
Authenticated password change verifies the current user's account password and rotates its security stamp.
Unsafe authenticated/account operations retain CSRF token validation.
Audit persistence failures emit warnings; audit details remain empty JSON without secrets.
Account-management and audit-event screens are still absent.

next_slice.summary: RBAC/audit QA is complete. Remaining product work is the expected account/audit UI; optional future integration tests could exercise live cookie, CSRF, and audit status behavior.
